Chronic inflam arthropathy of the axial skeleton
– spine & sacroiliac joints w/ progress spine stiffness (ankylosis = stiff of joints ← fusion of the joints)
•HLA-B27 dz: PAIR (Psoriatic arthritis, Ankylosing spondylitis, Inflammatory bowel dz, Reactive arthritis)
•insidious onset; night pain (most severe at night); ⍉relieved by rest
•hyperkyphosis w/in 1st 10yrs of dz; hip + shoulder joints may be affected
•also: peripheral arthritis, TMJ pain, psoriasis, IBD, osteopenia, CV dz (eg ACS, thromboembolism, stroke)
•Pulm fibrosis (↓chest expansion); apical; restrictive pulm dz
•bilat sacroiliitis = hallmark; occurs early; usu the earliest XR finding
= straightening of the spine (loss of norm lumbar curvature) + squaring & fusion of the vertebrae
•syndesmophytes bridging multiple vertebrae; posterior facet joint fusion
•corticosteroids generally avoided (minimal impact; may worsen osteopenia)
